name: playwright-tests-for-resume-builder
description: System (end-to-end) tests for the resume builder in the parent directory, run against both shells (vanilla and React). Kept in its own package so it can move to a separate repository later.

scripts.perf: npm --prefix .. run build && npm --prefix ../resume-builder-react run build && node perf/build-react-initial.mts && playwright test -c playwright.perf.config.ts && node perf/report.mts
